items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Hank Jones could’ve done it, but Hank was working on the staff at ABC.

ctx.x: Excuse me, who else was in that band?

Sahib Shihab was on baritone. Jerome Richardson was in the band. There was a very fine trumpet player named Ray Copeland. James Cleveland was in the band. It wasn’t like a sixteen piece band. Maybe it was like twelve pieces or something like that, I can’t remember everyone’s name. Hank Jones was there. Oscar was one of the monumental bassists in the history of jazz. Joe Harris was playing drums or else Osie Johnson playing drums. It was a good band, it was a positive experience really.
Did you work much? I mean, big bands in the late fifties…
